claims: A focus exported in your shell cuts the gate's self-test down during `--no-lock` runs: the guard at `scripts/agent-quality-gate.test.sh:600-604` only refuses a focus when `AGENT_QUALITY_GATE_LOCK_HELD` or `GITHUB_ACTIONS` is set, so with `--no-lock` or `AGENT_QUALITY_GATE_LOCK=0` the mapped test script inherits the focus, runs one family, and exits 0
The same wrong statement appears in the comment at `:595-597` and in the doc at `docs/notes/agent-quality-gate-mechanics.md:1143-1146`

The whole-run success stamp still gets written (`agent-quality-gate.sh:5866-5878`) and `stamp_line` (`:4764-4773`) never looks at the environment, so a focused `--no-lock` run lets a later push with `--skip-if-fresh` skip the full self-test entirely, breaking the rule in `scripts/AGENTS.md:164-166`

Tests added above the partition aren't caught: the checker only covers lines from the `# >>> gate family body start` marker to the end of the file, so an `assert_contains` line inserted above the `verify_gate_family_partition` call passes the check and would run in every focused mode

judge_reasoning.3829986398: Review doesn't mention the abort trap expanding unset output_file under set -u.
judge_reasoning.3829986403: Review's partition mutation tests don't cover multiple dispatch calls being accepted.
judge_reasoning.3830003055: Review doesn't note that a missing dispatch call passes validation. It says a line after the end marker gives exit 1, which is not the same issue.
judge_reasoning.3830042123: Review's must-fix #1 is exactly this: the focus guard allows GATE_TEST_FOCUS during --no-lock or AGENT_QUALITY_GATE_LOCK=0 runs.
judge_reasoning.3830042128: Review doesn't mention the hard-coded path pin missing from the path-pin inventory.
judge_reasoning.3830695396: Review mentions the doc text only for the lock-guard inaccuracy, not the 'is set' vs non-empty wording or 'reds the suite'.

1.why: The guard at test.sh:600-604 does only check AGENT_QUALITY_GATE_LOCK_HELD and GITHUB_ACTIONS, and the gate exports LOCK_HELD at gate.sh:1143 only after taking the lock. This is the known defect at :628, 'Reject focus during lock-free gate runs'.

2.why: The comment at test.sh:595-597 and the doc at mechanics.md:1143-1146 do overstate that the focus can't shrink the gate's self-test. But that is the same lock-free focus defect already known at :628, just described again.

3.why: stamp_line (gate.sh:4764-4773) contains no environment input, and the success stamp is written at :5866-5878. This is only a downstream effect of the known lock-free focus defect (:628), not a separate bug.

4.why: In the awk checker, 'body == 0 { previous = $0; next }' (test.sh:509) skips every line before the '# >>> gate family body start' marker. So an assert line placed above the verify_gate_family_partition call passes the check and runs in every focused mode, even though the doc says the check fails the suite for any test line outside every family.
